title: CLI-wide compatibility-shim bootstrap and candidate-freeze retry

proposal_scope.title: CLI-wide compatibility-shim bootstrap and candidate-freeze retry
proposal_scope.hypothesis: Installing the existing hash-bound src.data compatibility shim once at direct CLI startup, before argument parsing and operation dispatch, will make capture-entry-snapshot, prepare-runner-snapshot, and candidate-freeze share the same deterministic import contract while leaving the frozen non-odds candidate policy unchanged.
proposal_scope.null_hypothesis: The direct CLI still cannot execute the exact three-operation pipeline, or the unchanged adapter cannot retain all 12 target races without market inputs, future data, probability violations, unverifiable hashes, or production/order side effects.
proposal_scope.racing_mechanism: The frozen non-odds Top3-set softmax assigns probability to every valid unordered three-horse set. Coherent WIDE pair marginals are derived by summing all sets containing each pair, and the deterministic maximum marginal with a fixed horse-id tie-break becomes WIDE_1. Market data can never alter the race, horses, pair, or rank.
proposal_scope.target_population: All 12 races at the pre-registered 2026-08-02 2nd Niigata meeting day 4 card. Every target race remains in the denominator even when entry, history, feature, bundle, universe, probability, or persistence contracts fail. Preparation uses synthetic fixtures only; real Sunday entry access and inference require a separate APPROVED_TO_RUN grant.
in_scope: Allow only model features enumerated by the hash-bound frozen feature schema
Blank and reject current odds, popularity, payout, result, final-odds, and market-derived candidate inputs
Bootstrap the resolved repository root on sys.path before any repository-local import when and only when the adapter is launched by the canonical direct-file command
Build a research-only runner snapshot from entry identity fields and source-time-valid local history blocks
Emit packet files consumable by EXP-20260801-004 without invoking odds, dashboard, notification, or order code
Enumerate every valid unordered Top3 set after the frozen starter universe is established
Exercise the actual direct script --help entrypoint in an isolated subprocess, proving repository-root and src.data bootstrap before any real-data run
Install the existing src.data compatibility shim at main entry before argument parsing so every direct CLI operation receives the same import contract
Load one exact hash-bound frozen coherent Top3-set inference bundle
Persist one append-only candidate-freeze packet or one deterministic failure packet for every target race
Pre-register the complete 2026-08-02 Niigata 12-race card without using odds
Read a hash-bound local entry snapshot or a pre-registered public pre-race entry source only after APPROVED_TO_RUN
Read back and verify each packet hash and persistence acknowledgement
Real pre-race Sunday entry, history, inference, and freeze execution only after APPROVED_TO_RUN
Reject rather than impute any pipeline-critical missing runner identity, universe, or lineage field
Select exactly one WIDE_1 candidate with a deterministic canonical horse-id tie-break
Synthetic fixture tests only during APPROVED_TO_PREPARE
Verify Top3-set probability mass equals one and derived WIDE probability mass equals three within 1e-10
out_of_scope: Any candidate replacement, pair search, ticket search, or race selection after market access
Any current odds, popularity, market rank, payoff, result, final odds, ROI, or derivative as candidate input
Any formal BUY, stake, credential access, purchase adapter, TARGET order handoff, or order transmission
Any omission of a failed target race from the candidate-freeze denominator
Any production dashboard mutation, production prediction overwrite, BUY-logic modification, or notification
Any real Sunday page, local Sunday runner row, or historical real race row during APPROVED_TO_PREPARE
Any reuse of a model artifact whose hash or feature schema differs from the canonical run scope
Any training, refit, backtest, ROI calculation, result join, threshold tuning, or model comparison
lineage_hash_requirements: Candidate tie-break must be deterministic and independent of odds, popularity, and outcomes
Candidate-freeze commit and read-back persistence acknowledgement must occur before EXP-20260801-004 can start odds access
Every output must set candidate_uses_odds false, formal_buy false, send_order false, and stake zero
Every target race must have exactly one packet even when no candidate can be generated
For candidate-ready rows, feature_input_max_source_event_time must be at or before candidate_feature_cutoff_time
Starter-universe identity and all runner IDs must be fixed before Top3-set enumeration
Target manifest, entry source, runner snapshot, feature source manifest, inference bundle, feature schema, candidate policy, and every packet must be SHA-256 bound
The adapter must not import or invoke production dashboard, notification, credential, or order-capable modules
Top3-set mass must equal one and WIDE-pair mass must equal three within 1e-10
rejection_gate: Any ROI calculation, threshold tuning, model refit, or outcome-based target exclusion
Any Top3-set or WIDE probability-mass violation is accepted
Any candidate changes after persistence acknowledgement
Any candidate-ready row has a future source time, unverified source, missing runner identity, or starter-universe mismatch
Any duplicate packet or non-idempotent restart behavior
Any formal BUY, stake, TARGET handoff, notification, or order side effect
Any inference bundle, feature schema, candidate policy, input snapshot, or packet hash cannot be verified
Any odds, popularity, market, payout, result, or post-race field influences the candidate
Any pre-registered target race is absent from the packet ledger
Any production dashboard mutation or import of notification, credential, or order-capable code
Any real Sunday or historical real race data access during preparation
stop_conditions: A forbidden market or post-race field reaches candidate construction
A formal_buy, send_order, or nonzero stake field becomes active
A production or order-capable module is imported or executed
A real Sunday source must be read before APPROVED_TO_RUN
A target race cannot be represented by either a valid candidate-ready packet or a deterministic failure packet
Any direct CLI operation can reach repository-local imports before the compatibility shim is installed
Feature source-time availability cannot be proven
The canonical direct-file smoke test cannot import repository-local src modules from a clean detached worktree
The complete starter universe cannot be frozen before Top3-set enumeration
The exact inference bundle or feature schema cannot be hash-bound
The registered target or synthetic manifest hash changes
raw_data_sources: Frozen M1C coherent Top3-set inference bundle and feature-schema manifest
Frozen action-calibrator and confidence-policy metadata for audit output only; neither may change the selected pair
Hash-bound local TARGET/JRA runner snapshot when available before race time
Hash-bound local historical feature stores whose source event times precede the candidate cutoff
Pre-registered public JRA or netkeiba entry page restricted to runner identity and schedule fields when local entry data is absent
proposal_scope.data_as_of: 2026-08-02 before the first registered candidate cutoff. Preparation is synthetic only. EXP-20260802-006 captured 12 public entry pages but produced no runner or candidate; those real artifacts are not read or reused during preparation.

chronological_fold_design.design: A deterministic synthetic preparation suite followed, only after separate run approval, by one pre-registered chronological Grade-R card containing all 12 races.
chronological_fold_design.downstream_rule: Only hash-verified candidate-ready packets may be consumed by EXP-20260801-004, and the downstream pilot may never mutate the candidate.
chronological_fold_design.failure_denominator_rule: Every target race remains in the candidate-freeze ledger; failures are explicit packets rather than dropped rows.
chronological_fold_design.ordering: source event and receipt <= feature cutoff <= candidate generation start <= generation completion <= freeze commit <= freeze persistence acknowledgement < any later odds join
chronological_fold_design.real_data_rule: No real Sunday entry page, local Sunday runner row, historical real race row, or market row may be read during APPROVED_TO_PREPARE.
chronological_fold_design.target_selection_rule: The entire 2026-08-02 Niigata card and race numbers 1 through 12 are fixed before observing race-day odds.

purge_embargo.market_firewall: No odds, popularity, market rank, payout, result, or final-odds field may enter candidate construction, feature calculation, tie-break, or target selection.
purge_embargo.post_event_embargo: No source event or label timestamp later than the candidate cutoff may be used.
purge_embargo.target_selection_embargo: No race may be added, removed, or manually prioritized after observing market data.

primary_metric.baseline: EXP-20260802-006 captured all 12 entry pages, then failed before runner output because src.data compatibility modules were not installed for the prepare-runner-snapshot process.
primary_metric.evaluation: All 12 pre-registered races, including each source, feature, bundle, universe, probability, and persistence failure packet
primary_metric.name: candidate_freeze_packet_ledger_completeness

notes: Successor to INVALID EXP-20260802-006. Scope is limited to installing the existing compatibility shim at CLI startup and rerunning the unchanged pre-registered candidate-freeze pipeline.
